trust_decision.summary: Nothing is decided at the pinned commit: both HTTP serving stacks hand every request to the MCP handler with no regard for Host or Origin, so the fix introduces the decision itself as one guard mounted in front of /mcp and applied before auth.

landing_point.why: It is the only HTTP wiring in the repository: the advisory names the Streamable HTTP transport, and this block is where MCP_LISTEN_ADDR/MCP_AUTH_TOKEN are read and the mcp-go handler is mounted or started.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST /mcp — every request on the HTTP transport
HTTP transport configured by MCP_LISTEN_ADDR (plus new MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS / MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS)
HTTP POST /mcp with MCP_AUTH_TOKEN set — bearerAuth mux stack
HTTP POST /mcp with no auth token — default config, previously served by StreamableHTTPServer.Start
fix_sites.module_kind: process wiring / listener construction in cmd/server (package main)

fix_sites.entry_point: process start — environment-driven transport selection (TRANSPORT, MCP_LISTEN_ADDR)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The mux path already requires a secret bearer token, so a solver argues a malicious web page cannot drive it and only the unauthenticated default path needs a Host/Origin check — yet the fix puts the guard outside auth so an untrusted Host returns 403 before the token is examined (fix.diff:157-161, fix.diff:767-770).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-browser MCP clients send no Origin header and must still get 200 (fix.diff:689-699), the documented zero-config setup must keep working from localhost:<port> and [::1]:<port> on any configured port, not one hard-coded 127.0.0.1:8080 (README.md:80, README.md:100-103), and the literal wildcard bind value 0.0.0.0:<port> must NOT become a trusted Host even though loopback names on that same port must stay trusted (fix.diff:105-108, fix.diff:389-399).

O6_input_shapes: Host header with an explicit port: 127.0.0.1:8080, localhost:8080, [::1]:8080 accepted; a foreign name such as attacker.example:8080 rejected (fix.diff:98-113)
Origin absent (allowed for CLI/LLM clients) vs present-and-trusted vs present-and-untrusted, which is rejected even on a trusted Host (fix.diff:141, fix.diff:714-725)
Origin value carrying a trailing slash, trimmed before comparison (fix.diff:123-126, fix.diff:141)
MCP_LISTEN_ADDR shapes: default loopback, wildcard 0.0.0.0 / :: / [::], a concrete non-loopback host, and a string with no port or that does not parse (fix.diff:73-79, fix.diff:98-108)
Comma-separated allowlists with surrounding whitespace and empty entries, split and trimmed (fix.diff:83-91)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second route (/sse, /messages) registered on the same mux beside /mcp without the guard
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ROADMAP.md:42 lists SSE transport as planned and ROADMAP.md:33 lists HTTP session management; the obvious implementation is another mux.Handle in the same wiring, which is exactly the place a guard can be forgotten.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A retained or legacy StreamableHTTPServer.Start(addr) path for one mode, which no middleware can wrap
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pinned code already serves the default configuration through Start(); keeping it for a debug or standalone mode is a one-line change, and the fix has to build its own http.Server to get a seam at all.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A reverse-proxy trust path that reads X-Forwarded-Host / X-Forwarded-Proto and normalises the host differently from r.Host
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix's own documentation pushes operators to run behind a reverse proxy and allowlist the proxy name (fix.diff:20-24, fix.diff:34-44); a proxy-header branch is the natural next commit, and its identity parsing (comma-separated list, missing port) is a different mechanism from the exact r.Host map lookup.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Transport allowlist produced by LoadACSConfig with defaults merged over environment values
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other deployment setting is read through this struct; a maintainer extending it would move MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS there, making the guard depend on a producer in another package rather than an inline os.Getenv.

O9_family: origin/Host validation for a local HTTP listener (CWE-346 Origin Validation Error — DNS rebinding)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.5 (go.mod:3); stdlib net/http plus github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go v0.54.1 (go.mod:7); no vendor directory, so go mod download needs network once; Dockerfile:9 builds with golang:1.26
O10_build.project_tests: CI runs go test -v -race ./... (.github/workflows/ci.yml:27); suites exist for client/, internal/tools/, internal/resources/, config/ and version/, all against httptest servers; there is no test for cmd/server at the pinned commit (cmd/server/main_test.go first appears in the fix, fix.diff:338-343). The guard is exercisable with net/http/httptest and needs no GenieACS backend.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap only the bearerAuth mux branch in a Host check and leave the default no-token StreamableHTTPServer.Start path open (or require an Origin header, breaking non-browser clients).

out_of_scope_notes: Adjacent to, but not part of, the published fix: an empty host in MCP_LISTEN_ADDR (e.g. ':8080') is judged loopback by isLoopbackAddr (cmd/server/main.go:26-28), so no bearer token is demanded while the socket binds all interfaces; not pursued.
unverified: Repository byte size was not measured (no shell this session); tiny_repo is inferred from the pinned tree — 31 Go files, the largest being cmd/server/main.go at 115 lines and client/acs_test.go at roughly 750 lines — plus two docs images.

Whether a cross-origin browser POST with an Authorization header is stopped earlier by a CORS preflight in mcp-go was not checked.
